title: Settings
subtitle: Update your display name and photo, choose how you receive notifications, switch between light and dark theme, change your password, enable two-factor authentication, manage active sessions, export your data, or delete your account — all in one place.
tabs.profileDesc: Your name, email, and public details
tabs.notificationsDesc: Choose when and how we reach you
tabs.accountDesc: Linked data, preferences, and danger zone
profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Update your display name and photo — this is what other community members see when they interact with you in groups, messages, and posts.
profile.emailHint: To change your email, please contact support.
profile.timezoneHint: Used for slot reminders and the calendar.
validation.nameMin: Name must be at least 2 characters
notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Choose how and when TGAW reaches you — pick between email alerts and browser push notifications for new messages, prayer updates, and important community broadcasts.
notifications.newMessagesEmail: Email me when someone sends me a message
notifications.prayerUpdatesEmail: Email me when a prayer request I follow is updated
notifications.broadcastsDesc: Receive important updates from the TGAW team
notifications.pushNewMessagesDesc: Notify me instantly when a message arrives
notifications.pushPrayerDesc: Notify me when a followed prayer request changes
push.title: Browser push notifications
push.blocked: Blocked — enable in browser site settings
push.prompt: Allow notifications to get instant alerts
push.notSupported: Notifications not supported in this browser
push.blockedToast: Notifications blocked — enable in browser settings
push.unavailable: Your browser's push service is unavailable (common on Chromium/Brave builds without Google integration, or networks blocking fcm.googleapis.com). Try Firefox or Google Chrome.
appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Switch between light, dark, or system-default theme to match your preference or device settings.
language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the language used across the dashboard. Your choice is saved to your account and this device.
security.title: Security
security.description: Change your password, enable two-factor authentication for extra protection, and manage the devices currently signed into your account.
security.tfaDesc: Add an extra layer of security with an authenticator app.
security.setPasswordHint: You signed in with an OAuth provider and don't have a password yet. Set one so you can also log in with email and password.
security.logoutDesc: This will terminate all other active sessions except for your current browser session. You will need to log back in on those devices.
security.terminateDesc: This will instantly log this device out of your TGAW account.
toast.setupTokenFailed: Could not generate setup token. Check your password.
account.title: Account
account.description: Export your data, manage your calendar feed, or permanently delete your account and all associated information.
account.icalDesc: Regenerate your private feed token to log out all calendar apps.
account.exportDesc: Get a full copy of your posts, messages, bookmarks, and calendar bookings.
account.signOutDesc: Sign out of TGAW on this browser session.
account.deleteDesc: Permanently remove your account and all associated data from TGAW.
account.deleteDescLong: This action is completely irreversible. This will permanently delete your profile, posts, comments, likes, private chat history, and bookings.
account.oauthNote: You signed in with OAuth, so no password is required for deletion.
toast.exportDone: Export finished! Data emailed and downloaded.
tfa.enableDesc: Secure your TGAW account with TOTP codes.
tfa.authHint: Please enter your current account password to begin two-factor setup.
tfa.scanDesc: Open your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password, etc.) and scan this code.
tfa.enabledDesc: Save these recovery backup codes in a safe place. You can use them to log in if you lose access to your authenticator app. They will not be displayed again.
tfa.saved: I have saved my backup codes
tfa.disableDesc: Are you sure? This reduces your account security.
tfa.regenDesc: Generate a fresh set of recovery codes. Your old codes will stop working.
tfa.regenDoneDesc: Save these recovery backup codes in a safe place. They will not be displayed again.
avatar.dialogDescription: Upload a clear photo to help community members recognize you.
avatar.toastInvalidType: Please select a valid image file (PNG, JPG, WEBP).
avatar.toastTooLarge: Image file size must be less than 1MB.
avatar.toastChooseFirst: Please choose a photo to upload.
avatar.toastUnavailable: Photo upload is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
avatar.toastInvalidSig: Upload failed — please refresh the page and try again.
